claims.quote: Haploinsufficient deletions of GABA transporter 1 (GAT-1)- encoding SLC6A1, and GABA transporter 3 (GAT-3)-encoding SLC6A11 are implicated in epileptic syndromes.
Chromosomal microarray analysis identified a deletion affecting one allele of both SLC6A1 and SLC6A11 in two pediatric patients with 3p- syndrome.

claims.object_text: reduced GABA uptake and protein expression
claims.quote: The haploinsufficient GAT-1 and GAT-3 conditions demonstrated reduced GABA uptake and protein expression, comparable to known SLC6A1 missense variants.

Haploinsufficiency of SLC6A1 and SLC6A11 contributes to the epileptic phenotypes observed in 3p- syndrome, marking this as the first study to biochemically characterize the functional impact of these deletions.
Post-treatment EEGs showed a moderate reduction in epileptiform discharges following PBA administration, and patients exhibited improved motor function.
